# Iframe

The `<Iframe>` block embeds a web page in a runbook. A frame loads only after you click **Load page**, and the title bar always shows where the page comes from.

## Reference docs next to the steps

Keep the docs for a block open while you work through a runbook.

<Iframe src="https://runbooks.gruntwork.io/authoring/blocks/command/" title="Command block docs" height={600} />

## A frame sized to the window

`height` takes a pixel count or any CSS length. This frame is 50% of the window's height.

<Iframe src="https://runbooks.gruntwork.io/authoring/runbook-structure/" title="Runbook structure" height="50vh" />

## A page from the runbook's assets folder

This page lives at `assets/site/index.html`. Its stylesheet and script load from the same folder through relative paths.

<Iframe src="./assets/site/index.html" title="Local site" height={260} />

## A page that exchanges values with the runbook

This picker lives at `assets/picker/index.html`. It receives the environment from the Inputs block below, and the region you pick becomes the Iframe block's `region` output, which the Command after it reads.

<Inputs id="deploy-config">
```yaml
variables:
  - name: environment
    type: string
    description: Environment to deploy
    default: staging
```
</Inputs>

<Iframe id="region-picker" src="./assets/picker/index.html" title="Region picker" height={220} inputsId="deploy-config" outputs={["region"]} />

<Command id="show-region" inputsId="deploy-config" command="echo 'Deploying {{ .inputs.environment }} to {{ .outputs.region_picker.region }}'" />
